info.title: Roslynaut
info.description: An MCP server that exposes Roslyn and MSBuild to agents: navigation, analysis, refactoring, builds and tests, IL/JIT disassembly, decompilation, process inspection and debugging of C# projects.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: An MCP server that exposes Roslyn and MSBuild to agents.

options.name: --protocol
options.description: The transport that carries MCP. [default: stdio]

options.name: --disable-tools
options.description: Leave these tools out, also when --enable-tools names them.

options.name: --no-instructions
options.description: Leave out the server instructions, which tell agents which tool to use for what. [default: False]

options.name: --install
options.description: Register the server with this agent for all projects, with a hook that suggests its tools when the agent reads or greps C# files, and exit.

options.name: --uninstall
options.description: Remove the server and its hook from this agent, as before uninstalling the tool, and exit.
